newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber prices close mixed in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber prices close mixed in quiet market.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended the week mixed on weak consumer demand, traders said.
A late rebound of the Tokyo futures market and emergence of some European inquiries for SMR 20 and latex failed to bring business, said the traders.
"Basically, it was a quiet day with nothing to report," said a trader.

"Buyers are still hoping for lower prices although they may have to do some covering soon," said another trader. "Producers are holding at current levels because rains are threatening to affect production."
